answer: We formalize a protocol where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds require validators to bridge liquid assets into a slashing matrix, ensuring that identity duplication triggers an immediate falcon protocol for cryptoeconomic revocation. Each malicious actor must mirror their staking collateral across N identities, where the non-linear penalty function exceeds the marginal yield of fractionalized power.
